scope: Fresh discovery probe; no continuation, mutation or pooling of any Enterprise078 or other owner's account.
thesis: Independent producers could undertake complementary work that is unattractive or unfundable separately if a synthesized contingent production-and-payment schedule preserves each participant's outside option and liquidity at every prefix.
residual: UNKNOWN: strong conventional combinatorial optimization and contracts may already provide the complete route.
decision: A complete-alternative tie rejects extraordinary advantage. No physical, privacy, buyer-demand or market-calibration claim.
construction: Executable finite-state schedule constructor with prerequisites, indivisible work, per-owner cash, protected reserves, explicit consent, accepted-output-gated transfers, failure and withdrawal. Independent time-expanded MILP comparator and replay.
comparisons: competent conventional exact MILP with identical actions and resources
information: Only declared current tasks, acceptance conditions, costs, capacities, consent and collectible committed amounts. No hidden future or test labels passed to constructor.
costs: Integer USD in authored conditional planning fixtures, including explicit complete cost envelopes; not bills, calibrated production costs or measured willingness to pay. Research actual model/host/development costs UNKNOWN. No trial revenue booked.
native: No prospective new primary financial account opened until a source-bound complete-cost commercial action is justified. Exactly US$100000 required if opened; old 25000 account never topped up. Planning arithmetic is not a second accounting ledger and is never called native profit.
acceptance: Replay every task/transfer prefix; reject negative unrestricted cash, missing prerequisites, output-before-acceptance payment, missing consent/cost, buyer package worse than outside option, duplicate production or terminal liabilities omitted. Compare MILP optimum and constructive optimum for every fully specified finite case.
stop: Run registered cases once at frozen implementation. Keep defects as development failures. If incumbent ties or beats, stop claim and retain strongest reusable implementation; no larger sweep or price/demand adjustment.
successor: Distinct two-stage activity requires predecessor capability; compare same initial cash and all predecessor construction costs against fresh construction and equal-content conventional reuse. No claim of funded continuation without native event replay.
